title: Ocean FFT Shader
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) implementing the superposition of 8+ Gerstner waves in a custom vertex shader; (2) recalculating normals using analytical derivatives; (3) multilayer combination of Fresnel reflection, refraction, foam, and highlights in the fragment shader; (4) environment cube-map reflection; (5) calculating maxDisplacement on the JavaScript side or passing it back from the GPU; (6) real-time uniform updates for 5 parameters
